stage_definitions.RESEARCH_ONLY: Editorial review done; no active implementation PR positively identified for the primary Batch-specific work.
stage_definitions.OPEN_IMPLEMENTATION_PR: A PR explicitly claims implementation changes for this module; open and not merged; no deployment or release certification inferred.
stage_definitions.PARTIAL_IMPLEMENTATION_PR_OPEN: An open PR contains only a subset of the module's approved recommendations; others remain to implement or verify.
stage_definitions.NOT_RELEASE_CERTIFIED: No complete module-specific end-to-end acceptance and deployment verification established by this consolidation.

release_gates: Verify current main and both public/private PR owners; resolve merge conflicts and do not double-edit canonical prayer IDs.
Original text/provenance and separately reusable translation validated; unavailable or held witnesses explicitly labelled.
Latin/English/French displays are attested, with no AI-filled prayers or unlicensed PDF/audio.
Traditional 1962 vs 1909/2021 vs optional local usage clearly distinguished.
Canonical Prayer, Rosary, Mass, Devotions, Office, and Calendar reuse single text identity rather than copy blocks.
Targeted Node/source and state regression plus Playwright mobile/language/low-connectivity tests pass.
Merged pull request is on current main and exact deployed Vercel commit is verified against live navigation, with protected rollback retained.
No paid services, hosting migration, artificial timeline/sacramental completion, or new parallel Calendar.
